notes.title: Now 1v1 fight with your opponent
notes.content:
In order to create a more indulging experience for the players we've now included a free roam mode. Now players can 1v1 fight with their third person controllable character. 
To continue the game player's are supposed to reach the ring so that the Slap Game can be played. Until then players can fight each other damaging their health points.

notes.title: Quick Time Events are here
notes.content:
- Added a Quick Time Event based response for the opponent players. This little addition adds a bit of complexity to the game play of Mighty Slap. 
Now as an opponent you're supposed to respond to the QTE prompts that appear on screen in order to regain consciousness after getting slapped. 
Failing to do so results in taking double the damage but won't knock you even if your health is depleted leaving you vulnerable to loosing in the next opponent turn. 

- Added a visual feedback next to the player that shows the resultant damage that was made from the slap.

- Added an octagon to the environment of single player and multiplayer game mode.

We're also working on another update that will allow players to free roam and fight each other before the slapping game begins. This could take some time to develop and we're also reworking our goals for this game and reconsidering the features that were previously decided.

notes.title: Beat the QTE to regain consciousness
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457184/d6d6ba113e999d53d011223b1dd1f5dc6e56e8dd.gif[/img]

Working on a QTE for the opponent that get slapped. The difficulty of the QTE will be decided by the intensity of slap and if the player fails to react to QTE they will be knocked out. 
I know QTE's are frowned upon in many games where they break the flow of game play. I think this will be a nice addition to our game considering the opponent players didn't have anything to do but wait all this time.
